deities: Goddess Pochamma Devi (Sitala Devi, granite image)

history.summary: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: the well-known Baddi Pochamma Devalayam on Baddi Pochamma Street, Shiva Sai Nagar, Vemulawada, about 1.5 km from the bus stand and 0.5 km from the Raja Rajeshwara temple, near Sri Bhimeshwara Swamy Temple. Tradition says it was built by Baddiga Bhupathi, a Rashtrakuta king, as an ancient Sitala Devi shrine with a granite image of Pochamma Devi; the walls carry engraved sculptures. DATE FLAG: no source gives a precise construction date, so the Rashtrakuta-era attribution is provisional. Newly married brides traditionally offer Bonam here; it is customary to visit after the Rajanna temple. COORDINATE FLAG: the geocoder matched Baddi Pochamma Store on Baddi Pochamma Street (the street named after the temple), so coordinates mark the temple's street vicinity rather than a verified temple pin - verify.

name: Sri Baddi Pochamma Temple
town_description: Vemulawada, in Rajanna Sircilla district, is one of Telangana's foremost pilgrimage towns - once the Chalukya capital, now dominated by the Rajanna temple with satellite shrines (Bheemeshwara, Baddi Pochamma, Nampally Gutta) around it.
